description: Build and edit shopping lists. Reads: list, get. Writes (blocked on read-only accounts): generate (from menu_id, merges amounts), add, categorize, check, remove, share; delete is permanent (ask, then confirm=true). ALWAYS pass exclude (what to leave off) and aisles. Show it grouped by aisle. Returns the list {id, title, sections:[{section, items:[{id, name, amount, checked}]}], remaining, total} or {lists:[...]}.

aisles.description: {item name: aisle}; aisle one of Produce|Meat & Seafood|Dairy & Eggs|Bakery|Pantry|Spices & Seasonings|Frozen|Beverages & Alcohol|Other

checked.description: check: true = got it, false = uncheck; default true

confirm.description: Must be true for delete, only after the user agreed

exclude.description: Items to leave off (e.g. pantry staples the user has), or []

items.description: add: "2 lb chicken" or {name, amount, aisle}; categorize: [{id, aisle}]

new.description: generate: make a 2nd list for a menu that has one (else refreshes it)

name: shopping_list
title: Shopping lists
